NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Add one photo to this chat. Nothing is sent as a message until you tap Send.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record a short note; your computer writes it out as text for you to check.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Add your current location to the message box for review. No background location is used.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan pairing QR. Take a photo.
